Delicious Japanese near the beach
Aug 2025 • Solo
Went to this place for dinner on the way from the beach, because it's literally across the street. Inside are two floors, and you can see that the establishment is actively working for delivery. I was wearing beach clothes, so they put me on the first floor. There's a small open kitchen and a table that looks like a bar. You can watch cooking is a plus. There's a fridge-showcase with seafood, everything looks fresh. Japanese cuisine on the menu, prices are quite adequate. I ordered sashimi semogi and katsudon. The order came quickly. The sashimi serve is good - in the ice boat. Pieces are thick, fish fresh. Katsudon is cooked right too. Later I came in here again and tried the rolls - still delicious, quality held. Portions are generous, tasted good. The service is nice.

Rooster living among cooking pots and pans
Nov 2019
I had lunch here with my family, the food was good for Nha Trang level. However, I stayed in a hotel nearby and later that evening I was disgusted to see that there is a rooster living in an enclosure where they also store their cooking pots and pans! One of the cooks was also touching the rooster! The next morning I was woke up by the same rooster crowing for two hours. This is unacceptable, live animals/poultry should not be any where near a restaurant.

They will scam you!
Jul 2018 • Family
If I could, I would give them 0 stars. First of all, sushi quality is terrible - there is better sushi at the shopping center down the street.
But more importantly they served us the slightly wrong item curry udon instead of curry rice which we started to eat because the kids were hungry. After about 5 minutes, they brought the curry rice and they said “sorry, please eat for me” pointing at the curry udon (the wrong item). Which anyone would assume meant, our mistake, this is on the House. Wrong! They charged us for both dishes and even with much discussion, they refused to take it off the bill apparently because the manager was not there.
So be aware and never accept anything you didn’t order, even if it’s similar and make sure to double check your bill before you pay

Small venue but good sashimi
